processes.california_capacity_weekly_report: Weekly compilation and email of California pipeline capacity, deliveries, and posted Gas Daily prices to the Transwestern management distribution list.
processes.capacity_contract_change_approval: Approving and relaying requests to increase or adjust pipeline contract capacity or receipts so scheduling/contract staff can amend the contract.
processes.terminated_deal_book_transfer: Identifying live or terminated deals for bankrupt counterparties and requesting they be moved into bankruptcy books.
processes.customer_price_quote_request: Relaying customer requests for forward gas price quotes to traders and returning the outcome.
